description: Link where the user buys or sells a game's token with their own wallet on idosgames.com (the trade panel opens pre-filled). The agent never trades on the server. To trade from a wallet you control, use the local @idosgames/mcp (quote_token_trade, build_token_trade, send_token_trade).

amount.description: Optional decimal amount: buy = pair currency to spend (e.g. "0.05"), sell = tokens to sell.

game_id.description: TitleID of the game whose token to trade.

name: prepare_token_trade
title: Prepare a token trade link
